mapper.select: SELECT m.stage_name, m.avatar, m.introduction, m.id, m.total_fans AS fansCount, m.total_income AS totalIncome, DATE_FORMAT(m.created_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS createdTime, u.id AS userId, u.email FROM musician m INNER JOIN user u ON m.user_id = u.id WHERE u.id = #{userId} AND u.user_status = 1 AND m.status = 1 amd m.is_deleted = 0

SELECT DISTINCT m.stage_name, m.avatar, m.introduction, m.id, m.total_fans AS fansCount, m.total_income AS totalIncome, DATE_FORMAT(m.created_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS createdTime, u.id AS userId, u.email FROM musician m INNER JOIN user u ON m.user_id = u.id
INNER JOIN singer_tag_relation str ON m.id = str.musician_id
WHERE u.user_status = 1 AND m.status = 1 and m.is_deleted = 0
AND m.stage_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{name}, '%')
AND str.tag_id IN
#{tagId}
ORDER BY m.created_time DESC
